description: This source file defines a Java class 'DefaultCommandPipeline' which implements the 'CommandPipeline' interface. It acts as a component to wrap a 'CommandExecutor' and provides a method to send commands by returning a Supplier of the result.

classes.name: DefaultCommandPipeline
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that implements CommandPipeline, delegating command execution to CommandExecutor.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Receives a command and returns a Supplier that, when invoked, executes the command via the executor.
